messages:
sarah: Morning — quick standup for the NovaHealth Dedicated pilot. What I did: ran demo yesterday, got initial SOC2 checklist to customer, and logged pilot intake. Blockers: legal wants detailed KMS/HSM integration notes and keywrap timeline before we sign; engineering PR needs one more review (see PR link). Today: follow up with security/legal, send HSM checklist, and get PR reviewed. https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-dedicated/pull/472

kevin: I can take the KMS/HSM writeup. Quick Q: which KMS provider customer is asking for? also need to confirm allowed algorithms. If it's on-prem HSM we should include attestation + network topology. I'll ping @maria-eng for PR review.

kevin: sample snippet I'll share with them (TL;DR):
```
primary_kms: aws-kms
key_wrap: RSA-OAEP-256
kms_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rw-inference-kms-read
hsm_profile: fips-140-2-level-3
network: private-link -> dedicated-pool
```

maria-eng: on it — will review PR today and aim to merge before EOD if no major comments. @ops-bot can you attach the last audit log export and the network diagram to the ticket?

ops-bot: attached audit_export_2024-11-20.zip to ticket RW-489; uploaded network-topology-v2.pdf to the intake.

security: Heads-up: legal needs a clear data-flow diagram showing token lifecycle, KMS rotation policy, and whether any plaintext tokens leave the customer VPC. Also need confirmation of HSM vendor + FIPS attestation docs. @kevin can you confirm the token flow (brief)?

kevin: Confirm: inference tokens never exit the customer VPC. Key wrapping happens at customer KMS/HSM; we store only wrapped keys and KV caches in our dedicated pool behind private-link. HSM vendor (AcmeHSM) provides FIPS140-2 Level 3 report. I'll attach certs.

ben-sales: Deal-side note: customer asked about pilot SLA and rollback plan — want assurance on uptime and an explicit fallback if dedicated capacity has issues. Should we propose 99.9% for pilot + automatic fallback to hosted with data isolation guarantees? @olivia any pricing/contract implications?

olivia: 99.9% is fine for a pilot. Burst to hosted will be billed as usage overage; I'll estimate expected leakage and send numbers to @sarah offline. :+1:

ryan: I'll book a 30m sync with eng-security + legal at 14:00 PT today to close outstanding asks. @sarah please add the PR and the network diagram to agenda.

sarah: Added agenda: 1) KMS/HSM details + certs 2) rollback & fallback policy 3) PR review timeline. Thanks all — tagging for attention: @kevin @maria-eng @security.

kevin: quick follow-up — please confirm tonight if legal needs any additional encryption algorithm details. I can prepare a 1-pager for them.

maria-eng: will confirm by 5pm PT, otherwise I'll ask for specifics during the 14:00 sync.

ben-sales: acked, thanks team.

olivia: sending pricing estimate to Sarah now.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: meeting RW-489 sync at 14:00 PT (in 2h).
